tool.name: RADAR-PD Utility: Send Project to GSAS-II
tool.description: select and preserve a RADAR-PD refinement checkpoint for GSAS-II
tool.command: touch '$output_project' '$handoff_metadata' '$handoff_report' '$console_output' && trap "chmod a+r '$output_project' '$handoff_metadata' '$handoff_report' '$console_output' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT && set -euo pipefail && handoff_args=(python /opt/radar-pd/scripts/ndip_gpx_handoff.py --project '$gpx_project' --project-name '$gpx_project.element_identifier') && #if str($gpx_index) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') handoff_args+=(--index '$gpx_index') && #end if handoff_args+=(--output-project '$output_project' --metadata '$handoff_metadata' --report '$handoff_report') && "\${handoff_args[@]}" > >(tee -a '$console_output') 2> >(tee -a '$console_output' >&2)

param.name: gpx_project
param.label: RADAR-PD GSAS-II project
param.help: Choose one checkpoint from the GPX collection returned by RADAR-PD Analyze.

data.name: output_project
data.label: GSAS-II project ready for interactive handoff

tool.help: Selects one GPX checkpoint from a RADAR-PD run, preserves it as a first-class Galaxy dataset, and attaches pipeline provenance. This is the workflow boundary for a future NDIP interactive GSAS-II GPX opener. It deliberately does not send an existing GPX to the current batch GSAS2 Refinement tool because that tool starts a new project from data, instrument, and CIF inputs.
